polityNote: Republic of Tunisia (independent 1956-03-20). Atoms: the 264 délégations of 2017 (geoBoundaries TUN ADM2, OpenStreetMap, ODbL), grouped by their 2017 governorate; re-based 2026-10-06 from Natural Earth, which lacked the Ariana/Manouba line of 2000. ① Union areas vs statoids (official) areas: within ±5 % for 17 of 24 governorates; Gafsa −16 % / Tozeur +28 % (their common line in OSM) and Sousse −18 % differ.
